Question: What are some amazing facts about airplanes?
Answer: 1.When a plane lands at night, cabin crews will dim the interior lights because in the unlikely event that the plane landing goes badly and passengers need to evacuate, their eyes will already be adjusted to the darkness. 2.Only 5% of the world’s population had ever been on an airplane till 2013 which drastically increased to approx. 20 percent in 2020. 3.A Boeing 747 is made up of six million parts which are made to be all controlled by a few pilots sitting up front with switches and buttons under their fingertips. 4.It is the rule that pilots must be fed the same multi-course meal given to those in the first and business class whilst the co-pilots are encouraged to eat different entrees to guard against cases of food poisoning. 5.Those white lines that planes leave in the sky are simply trails of condensation, hence their technical name of “contrails.” Plane engines release water vapor as part of the combustion process. When that hot water vapor is pumped out of the exhaust and hits the cooler air of the upper atmosphere, it creates those puffy white lines in the sky. It’s basically the same reaction as when you see your breath when it’s cold outside. 6.Environment inside an airplane actually alters the way food and drink tastes—sweet items tasted less sweet, while salty flavors were heightened. The dry recycled air inside the plane cabin doesn’t help either as low humidity can further dull taste and smell making everything in a plane seem bland. 7.Plane doors can't actually open in mid-flight. 8.Australian airline Qantas has never had a fatal accident involving one of its commercial aircrafts. 9.The fastest commercial plane flew at twice the speed of sound. It was the Concorde, that regularly flew over the Atlantic, and was decommissioned after an accident involving Concorde, in France. 10.Long-haul flights have secret bedrooms and a bathroom for flight attendants. 11.Living in an airplane flight path could harm your heart.Means closer to the airport.Individuals exposed to noise above 60 decibels on a regular basis—like the sound of an airplane overhead—had a 30 percent greater risk of dying from a heart attack than those typically exposed to noise levels under 45 decibels. 12.Research shows that the first 3 minutes after takeoff and the final 8 minutes before landing are when 80% of plane crashes happen. 13.About 1 in 5 people have some form of fear of flying, or “aviophobia.” 14.If you sit at the back of an airplane, your odds of surviving a crash are 40% higher. 15.What that tiny hole in the airplane window does is to regulate cabin pressure. Most airplane windows are made up of three panels of acrylic. The exterior window works as you would expect—keeping the elements out and maintaining cabin pressure. 16.Airplanes are designed to withstand lightning strikes. Question: What is the importance of discipline in life?
Answer: As an FC BARCELONA fan, I would like to point it out using the team’s example. So the team qualified to the semifinals of the UCL due to some great individual performances of some players and mainly the GOAT Messi. So the semifinal draw is out Liverpool face Barcelona. The first leg was to be played at the Camp Nou.The crowd was all pumped up as Leo Messi had promised the crowd to bring back the UCL at Camp Nou. So on the day Messi played brilliantly and provided a 3-0 lead which most people considered as ungettable. But the return fixture was at Anfield and for the non-football fans I would like to say that it is one of the most electrifying atmospheres in the world. So the second leg started and the atmosphere created was second to none and Messi created chances but was not able to score and the crowd totally disrupted the Barca team by its chants of You’ll Never Walk Alone. And then Liverpool scored and the first half score was 1-0. Barca had come here thinking of defending the lead as per Barca’s manager Valverde but one of the veterans Pique who had played in England said to the manager that this is not how you win in England. But he was said to shut up and listen. And this showed that they had not learned from their previous year's setback of Roma. And once again they played on the pitch with no discipline and the defence scattered so they conceded one goal after another and now the impossible looked possible. And now a corner was awarded and they were not paying attention to the corner as their confidence was totally down. And a quick corner was taken and the goal was struck and now the scoreline read 4-0 and the match ended and Barca were knocked out. So one lesson can be learnt from here that had they played with some discipline and intent of hitting on counters they would have achieved a goal which would have been a vital away goal. Had they sticked with a proper plan and played with proper discipline the goal was not far. So showing overconfidence and not doing things with proper plans and discipline would fetch you nothing instead steal the things that are in you grasp. So also in real life I would give you three cases Most of the people join it and some stay there for a month and skip it as it invites some pain but as they skip it,it invites more pain as the body gets used to it and no other exercise means a change in schedule and then the money goes too with no outcome. 2. Studies Some students try to take their studies till the end inviting pressure because had they started earlier and regularly that would be some less work at the end and disciplined planning would have led to some less mental pressure. 3. Work People at work tend to take half days or skip work so as to enjoy for some time and then they have to beg for deadline extension and then their boss assigns them a new project and again they have to work for two deadlines and from home too so as to cope with the work pressure. So the key or one of the key principles of living a great life is DISCIPLINE and without it you cannot achieve anything or hold on to it. MOTIVATION GETS YOU GOING BUT DISCIPLINE HELPS YOU IN GROWING.

Question: What do you think of the movie "Uri: The surgical Strike"?
Answer: Proud to be an Indian after seeing this movie. After seeing the trailer, I made up my mind that whatever happens I’m gonna watch this movie. The director and cast has done a great job.They divided the movie into chapters and explained the whole reason behind the happening of Surgical Strikes. They showed all the incidents in the past one year that happened before the surgical strikes.Pathankot attacks and all. The Man from DRDO who made the eagles(like drones). The scene in which the eagle is being caught by a terrorist was so much intense that it would stop someone’s breath. Great acting from the man and hats off to the actual man who made those eagles. Yami Gautam did an excellent job. Mainly the interrogation scene. Paresh Rawal performance was great. The great habit of breaking mobile phones, I once started counting how many mobiles he broke but as he was so good at it that I lost the count at last. Every time he broke a phone his manager would be ready with a new one and the people in the theater would laugh and scream everytime he broke a phone. Isha Talwar cameo like performance should be all of praise as whatever scenes were given to her she did full justice to that. The young girl when she shouted the War Cry the whole army completed it. In real, when it would have happened what would be the things that she would have gone through. She will never be able to see her father again. They removed the 72 hooron dialogue. They should have kept it as it was the main dialogue for which people came to watch the movie. Th attack on URI base camp was so bad that the terrorists killed our soldiers when they were sleeping. Our army gave the most epic reply. The most under-rated scene was when our Indian couple grabbed the information from that Pakistani person who attended the meeting regarding surgical strike and informed Ajit Doval about it and how the pilot turned the chopper back keeping the surgical strike alive. The mastermind of Ajit Doval that he travelled by Riksha so as to avoid media attention. The main dialogue was HOW’S THE JOSH? HIGH SIR. The people in the movie hall also shouted HIGH SIR. The last scene was epic that Vihan(Vicky Kaushal) dined with Modi and he kept his promise as he told Modi before surgical strikes that there will be no casualties in the attack. I would say that this was a MODERN DAY BORDER. Hats off to the army men and the masterminds behind the SURGICAL STRIKES. Edit : One scene I missed was when Major Vihan calls her pilot when they are just in trouble and are being fired by Pakistani chopper,at that time the pilot comes and remembers her husband’s name and shoots Pakistan’s chopper till it runs away. Thanks Mayank Verma. Edit: I would like to correct that The actress was Kriti Kulari not Isha Talwar. Thanks Bhanu. THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR LOVE AND UPVOTES. THIS IS MY FIFTH ANSWER AND I AM GLAD FOR THE 100+UPVOTES THAT I RECEIVED ON THIS ANSWER.
